fields.description: Line description / item text (mirrors Purchase Invoice Item description).
fields.label: Description

fields.description: Per-line tax. Plain Currency (no company-currency context at extraction); company-currency binding is deferred to promote (spec 04 D5).
fields.label: Tax Amount

fields.description: Visible PO ref for this line. Maps to Purchase Invoice Item purchase_order on promote; join key for the three-way match (spec 08).
fields.label: PO Reference

fields.description: Visible PR ref for this line. Maps to Purchase Invoice Item purchase_receipt on promote.
fields.label: PR Reference

fields.description: Backing currency code for the Currency columns above. Set to the capture's final/proposed currency at write-back.
fields.label: Currency

fields.description: Human-readable per-line confidence blurb (e.g. desc 0.95 / amount 0.88 / po 0.40). Authoritative numbers live in Document Capture Confidence keyed line_<i>_<field>.
fields.label: Confidence Summary
